name: Sun Cleric: Dawn streams its raw readiness restrictions; Radiant Conversion ends the active phase (#5741, #9727)
contract: Requires CoA.SendDisplayPatches=1. Raw Dawn 804584 requires caster aura 704396 (the hidden '20 Solar Power' marker) and excludes active Dawn 807440. #5741 first cleared both restrictions in the client SMSG_PATCH_SPELL row so Dawn could be recast to end the phase, which left Dawn looking usable at any Solar Power (#9727). Since #9438 the server supersedes Dawn with Radiant Conversion 807453 (CasterAuraSpell 807440) while the phase is active, so the cancel path no longer needs Dawn's own restrictions. The Dawn row (opcode 2346) must therefore carry the raw CasterAuraSpell 704396 at numeric field 24 and ExcludeCasterAuraSpell 807440 at field 26. Runeshroud 500639 is a control proving the login patch stream is present. This verifies emitted client data; client rendering and input remain outside the native harness. The Dawn aura 807440 must also stream with the raw non-shapeshifted attribute (65536) retained and the debuff and no-cancel attributes cleared, allowing manual buff cancellation.

steps.label: The existing login spell patch stream reaches this session
Dawn is included in the client patch stream
Dawn requires the twenty-Solar-Power readiness aura on the client
Active Dawn excludes Dawn itself; Radiant Conversion takes its button
The Dawn aura is included in the client patch stream
Dawn retains its non-shapeshifted flag and clears debuff and no-cancel flags
